summary: A single actionable step rendered as a checkable, editable log line.
purpose: Use as one row inside a list of steps or tasks. It pairs a completion checkbox with the step text and optional edit and delete actions. Reach for it instead of hand-building a checkbox row so completion styling and token discipline stay consistent.

anatomy.description: A padded row surface that animates in and nudges right on hover.
A grip glyph on the left; visual affordance only in this version.
Toggles completion; turns the success color when checked.
The step label; strikes through and dims when completed.
Edit and delete icon buttons, shown only when editable and not completed.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable identifier passed back to every handler.

props.name: isCompleted
props.description: Marks the step done; strikes and dims the row.

props.name: isEditable
props.description: Reveals edit and delete actions when the step is not completed.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Fired when the checkbox is toggled.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Fired when the edit action is used.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Fired when the delete action is used.

whenToUse: One row inside a checklist or a step-by-step plan.
A task the user can complete, and optionally edit or remove.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Rendering an ordered plan with numbering and structure
A standalone binary setting with no list context

do: Provide a stable id, since every handler is keyed by it.
Let isCompleted drive the strike-through and dim rather than styling text yourself.
Compose several inside PlanStepList or a Stack, not in isolation.
dont: Rely on the drag handle for reordering; it is visual only in this version.
Pass empty text; the row's accessible action labels are derived from it.

content.voice: Steps read as short imperative actions, verb first.
rules: Keep it to a single line where possible.

tokensUsed.usage: Row fill, at reduced alpha when completed.
Border and checkbox color on hover and rest.
Drag handle color and text color when completed.

keyboard: Edit and delete actions are reachable and activate with Enter or Space.
aria: Edit and delete icon buttons carry a row-specific aria-label ("Edit step: <text>" and "Delete step: <text>").
accessibility.contrast: Active text clears 4.5:1; completed text is intentionally dimmed and should not carry information that dimming alone hides.
accessibility.focus: Every interactive control shows a visible focus ring.

examples.title: Basic step
examples.code: <TaskItem id="1" text="Reply to the landlord" onToggle={onToggle} />

examples.title: Editable, incomplete
examples.code: <TaskItem id="2" text="Draft the email" isEditable onEdit={onEdit} onDelete={onDelete} />

related.whenToChoose: Use PlanStepList to render a whole plan; TaskItem is the single row it composes.
Use Checkbox for a lone toggle; TaskItem is a full list row with text and actions.
